credibility.line: Management misses capacity growth targets frequently and reports volatile profitability despite top-line growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed a net loss of 19 billion rupees for the September quarter, while reported Sep 2026 PAT was -1879.0 crore.
Management guided for flattish capacity growth in Q2 FY27, but Sep 2026 revenue grew 25.9% year-over-year to 23364.0 crore.
Reported numbers confirm severe financial strain, with Mar 2026 full-year PAT dropping to -2394.0 crore and D/E rising to 17.47.

bull: Jun 2026 quarter revenue grew 19.9% year-over-year to reach 24584.0 crore.
Sep 2026 quarter revenue showed strong top-line growth of 25.9% year-over-year to 23364.0 crore.
Total cash remains substantial at 527 billion rupees by the end of Q2 FY27.
bear: Sep 2026 quarter reported a heavy net loss of 1879.0 crore and negative EBIT margin of -5.0%.
Leverage has surged with Sep 2026 debt-to-equity ratio reaching 17.47 and borrowings at 87303.0 crore.
Full year Mar 2026 PAT turned negative to -2394.0 crore alongside an EBITDA drop to 12037.0 crore.
watch: Whether Q3 FY27 capacity actually grows in early single digits as guided in g4.1.
Evolution of the debt-to-equity ratio above the 17.47 level reported in Sep 2026.
Turnaround of negative EBIT margins which stood at -5.0% in Sep 2026.
